info.title: Apostolic Bible Retrieval API
info.description: Read-only public-domain English Bible API. Call listBooks, then getChapter using exact IDs and chapter strings. For a passage, retrieve its chapter(s) and select verse labels locally; preserve all matching records and their order. No query filtering is implemented.

get.summary: List all 87 books and their chapter identifiers
get.description: Public-domain English text. No authentication. Retain exact book labels and ordered records; never merge numbered versions.

404.description: Unknown book or chapter. Use the catalog values exactly.

get.summary: Get chapter URLs and record counts for one book
get.description: Public-domain English text. No authentication. Retain exact book labels and ordered records; never merge numbered versions.

parameters.name: book_id
parameters.description: Exact book_id from listBooks, e.g. genesis, 1-daniel, 2-daniel.

404.description: Unknown book or chapter. Use the catalog values exactly.

get.summary: Retrieve the exact ordered English records of one chapter
get.description: Public-domain English text. No authentication. Retain exact book labels and ordered records; never merge numbered versions.

parameters.name: book_id
parameters.description: Exact book_id from listBooks, e.g. genesis, 1-daniel, 2-daniel.

parameters.name: chapter
parameters.description: Exact chapter string from listBooks or getBookMetadata. Sirach includes "0".

record_index.description: One-based record position within this chapter. Distinguishes repeated verse labels.

verse.description: Exact supplied label; may repeat or be a range.

text.description: Exact English translation. May be empty.

404.description: Unknown book or chapter. Use the catalog values exactly.
